Find us

A tile showroom in south west Sydney

You will find us at 43-45 Bonnyrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg, a short drive from Fairfield, Cabramatta, Liverpool, Wetherill Park and Smithfield. Customers come to us from right across Sydney, and we deliver across Sydney metro.

Coming to pick up an order? Have a read of our vehicle loading policy before you set off.

Before you get in touch

Quick answers

When is the showroom open?

Monday to Friday 7am to 5pm and Saturday 7am to 3pm. We are closed on Sundays.

Can I enquire about several products at once?

Yes. Add tiles, bathroom ware, tapware and supplies to your enquiry cart as you browse, then send them all to us in one enquiry. No payment is taken online.

Do you offer a colour consultation?

Yes, and it is free. Bring your samples or photos to the showroom and our team will help you match tiles, tones and finishes.

Do you deliver?

You can pick up from our Bonnyrigg showroom or have your order delivered across Sydney metro. Let us know which you prefer when you send your enquiry.

I am a builder or tiler. Can you supply my jobs?

Yes. We supply tiles, adhesive, grout, waterproofing, trims and tools from the one showroom, and we open at 7am. Call (02) 8786 0288 to talk through what you need.
